anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system shows no recent learning cycles, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading metrics show zero active or closed trades, win rate, and ROI, which is unusual for an active trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation or system instability.
Review AI system configuration and performance to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and platform activity to ensure trades are being executed and monitored effectively.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, affecting trading operations and user experience.
